title: Field hint is hidden from the accessibility tree
description: The reference-code hint is visible on screen but carries aria-hidden=true, and the input's aria-describedby points at it. The instruction is therefore removed from the accessibility tree instead of being associated with the field.

relatedElements.note: Associates a hint that remains in the accessibility tree.

expectedBehaviour: An instruction needed to complete a field is programmatically associated with it and available to assistive technology.
actualBehaviour: The hint is aria-hidden and contributes no accessible description.
userImpact: Screen-reader users do not learn where to find the reference code.

detection.note: The text is visible, so an automated check that only looks for a description may treat the field as described.

manualTests: Move to the Reference code field in forms mode and listen for the hint.

assistiveTechnologyTests.procedure: Navigate to the target with the VoiceOver rotor and confirm what is announced.

assertions: The input's accessible description is empty while the hint text is visible.
tests: tests/subtle-defects.spec.js: keeps the hint hidden from assistive technology in variant A

reviewStatus.note: A Playwright regression test preserves the defective behaviour and its control. That is automated reproduction, not a manual or assistive-technology observation.
